name: send-gate
description: In a session that runs without permission prompts, holds an MCP tool call that would send a message or an email, notify people (an invitation, a share, a comment) or that a local config names (an app environment change, for example), and shows the target, the mentions and the dates until you let that one call through (a card in a pane, or the question dialog on a narrow terminal; refused when nobody answers). /send-gate shows the mode and the config, tests a tool name, lists tools that are neither gated nor a read, and answers a hold.

timeoutSeconds.title: Seconds before an unanswered hold is refused
timeoutSeconds.description: How long a held call waits for Send once or Cancel before it is refused (5 to 3600; default 120).

config.title: Site config file
config.description: Absolute path of the JSON file with the tool names to gate and to pass. Empty (default): <HOME>/.claude/send-gate.json.
